_about: Skyrim creatures that fight with the moves of one of MORDHAU's Demon Horde creatures (play-test notes, 2026-10-13/14: 'the gremlin without a jump would work for the falmer', 'make the various demon horde creatures be placed on the most relevant skyrim creatures that dont have a fighter assigned to them ... meaning make them use the animations'). Such a creature gets a fighting stand-in like a person does, only the stand-in is that Demon Horde creature with its own brain and attacks; the Skyrim creature's own body is put into its pose. This works because every Demon Horde creature is built on MORDHAU's ordinary 175-bone character skeleton (read in play: same bones, same order as the player's), and because these Skyrim creatures carry the same bones as Skyrim's people (read in play with the dev bone list: Falmer have them without the bracketed tags, trolls, werewolves, vampire lords, gargoyles, hagravens and frost atronachs with them; a Dwarven Centurion has about half). race_contains: pieces of the race's editor name, lower case, separated by |; the first matching row wins. demon: the MORDHAU creature (BP_DemonHordeEnemy_Special_<demon>). head_cm: how high that creature's head stands in MORDHAU at its own size (measured in play); the stand-in is scaled so that it stands as tall as the Skyrim creature - 0 = left at its own size. banned: pieces of the names of its moves that are broken off the moment they begin, separated by |. weapon: the MORDHAU weapon the stand-in holds ("" = none, its own claws); it is drawn in the Skyrim creature's hand too. person_strikes: 1 = it attacks with a person's ordinary strikes when its Skyrim creature attacks (for one whose own attacks are all left out). skyrim_bones: bones (their plain names, separated by |) that keep Skyrim's own pose - ones that carry Skyrim effects which move with them. weapon "own": its stand-in holds the MORDHAU weapon for the Skyrim weapon the creature holds (as a person's stand-in does), and the creature shows its own Skyrim weapon. (A row for the Dwarven Centurion on the Ogre's moves was tried on 2026-10-14 and taken out the same day at the user's word - 'just remove all the centurion stuff and keep it as it was': with half a person's bones it walked and swung badly, and the Ogre's every blow threw the player down.) A row with demon "" keeps that kind of creature Skyrim's alone: no MORDHAU stand-in of any kind. (Trolls were tried on MORDHAU's Troll on 2026-10-14 and taken out: 'just keep troll as before no mordhau standin', then 'keep the hidden target' - a troll has the hidden stand-in that only stands to be hit, as other creatures of its size do: builds.json creature_standin.)

rows.note: the Gremlin: small, hunched, claws. Its leap onto the player (BP_AbilityMotion_GremlinLeap) is left out, as asked. Holds MORDHAU's knife (play-test note 2026-10-14: "could you make it so the falmer holds a falmer knife in its hand"). head_cm 134 (2026-10-14, measured on the D: copy): crouched, the Gremlin carries its head 100 cm off the ground at its own size, the Falmer posed in that crouch 140 cm - your swings went over the Gremlin ("swinging at the falmer does nothing, but swinging at its feet hits it"). 134 makes the Gremlin 1.4 times its size for a Falmer of ordinary size (its height 146 units x 1.42875 x 0.9 / 134). Then (same day): 'why does he have a carving knife, and he looks at my feet' - MORDHAU's Knife is a small kitchen knife: the Falmer shows its own Falmer weapon now, its Gremlin holds the MORDHAU weapon that weapon maps to; and its neck and head keep Skyrim's pose (Skyrim turns them to the player - the Gremlin, crouched and not aimed at the player as people's stand-ins are, looked at the ground). Play-tested 2026-10-14 in the test room: 'falmers seem to be looking acceptable'
